definitions.explanation: A firefighting vehicle equipped with a water pump, used to draw water from hydrants or other sources and spray it at fires.

examples.japanese: ポンプ{車|しゃ}が{現場|げんば}に{到着|とうちゃく}した。
examples.english: The pumper truck arrived at the scene.

examples.japanese: {消防署|しょうぼうしょ}にはポンプ{車|しゃ}が{三台|さんだい}{配備|はいび}されている。
examples.english: Three pumper trucks are stationed at the fire department.

examples.japanese: ポンプ{車|しゃ}が{消火栓|しょうかせん}に{接続|せつぞく}して{放水|ほうすい}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: The pumper truck connected to the fire hydrant and began spraying water.

notes:
ポンプ{車|しゃ} is the most common type of fire truck in Japan. It carries a pump that can draw water from fire hydrants ({消火栓|しょうかせん}) or natural water sources and spray it through hoses. The full formal name is {消防|しょうぼう}ポンプ{自動車|じどうしゃ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ポンプ{車|しゃ}の{操作|そうさ} — operating a pumper truck
- {小型|こがた}ポンプ{車|しゃ} — small pumper truck (used in narrow streets)
- ポンプ{車|しゃ}の{放水|ほうすい}{訓練|くんれん} — pumper truck water discharge drill

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {消防車|しょうぼうしゃ} — fire truck; fire engine (general term)
- はしご{車|しゃ} — ladder truck (equipped with an extendable ladder)
- {救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ} — ambulance
